answer: One onyx bond of 100 credits per identity decays on a sonnet schedule: 14 lines, one per epoch, each shedding 5 credits. Every step is etched on the shale ledger, so the schedule is auditable. An active identity earns 5 back per epoch and holds; an idle one bleeds out. 1,000 sybils cost 1,000 bonds (100,000 credits) plus 5,000 credits in top-ups per epoch, against a 40,000-credit pool. An honest agent locks one bond once and keeps its share.
